mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `camera_capture_plan` (device_id, user_id, plot_id, plan_name, interval_minutes, weekdays_mask, start_time, end_time, timezone, enabled, apply_status, next_capture_time, version, remark, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{plotId}, #{planName}, #{intervalMinutes}, #{weekdaysMask}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{timezone}, #{enabled}, 0, #{nextCaptureTime}, 0, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE `camera_capture_plan` SET device_id = #{deviceId}, user_id = #{userId}, plot_id = #{plotId}, plan_name = #{planName}, interval_minutes = #{intervalMinutes}, weekdays_mask = #{weekdaysMask}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, timezone = #{timezone}, enabled = #{enabled}, apply_status = 0, last_apply_error = NULL, next_capture_time = #{nextCaptureTime}, version = version + 1, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
